messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync - CloudMarket asked for a marketplace listing with two SKUs (reserved and burst), SI onboarding discount, and a renewal credit that converts trial usage to commit. Need input on term lengths & SKU lock.
Omar Ruiz: Do they want marketplace metered billing or private offer invoice?
Maya Chen: They prefer a marketplace private offer so partners can seat it in their portal; billing via marketplace invoice is mandatory for co-sell.
Nina Shah: OK. For SI onboarding discount: 20% off first 6 months and enable partner-managed enablement credits. Need cap.
Carlos Mendes: Finance: cap onboarding credits per customer to protect reserves. Suggest table below as starting point.
Rita Zhou: Legal: need clear SKU lock (no price change) for 12 months; renewal conversion language for credits to be applied to new commit only. Also want a short abuse clause.
Maya Chen: Drafted credit rules below. Please review.
```
RenewalConversionRules:
- trial_usage_credit_applies_to_first_renewal_only
- credit_expires_90_days_after_renewal_offer_date
- credit_value = min(total_trial_units * unit_price * 0.5, onboarding_credit_cap)
```
Omar Ruiz: SI ask: can we pre-authorize partner discounts for completing enablement? They want $25k credit unlock after 3 certified workshops.
Nina Shah: We can, but tie to verified deliverables and signed Statement of Work. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
Carlos Mendes: Revised credit cap sketch: 
```
Commit band | Onboarding cap | SI enablement unlock
<$250k     | $25k           | $0
$250k-750k  | $100k          | $25k after 3 workshops
>750k       | $250k          | $50k after 3 workshops
```
Maya Chen: Good. Marketplace listing copy needs to show SKU attributes: term (12mo), units, burst multiplier (x2 for reserved SKU), and renewal credit line. I'll ping marketing for a short blurb.
Rita Zhou: Add abuse clause: sustained burst >2x committed baseline for 120 consecutive days -> revert to standard overage pricing and open commercial review.
Omar Ruiz: Partner requests a 30-day pilot removal window from public listing to collect feedback. Product?
Maya Chen: Product agreed to a 30-day pilot removal window but wants telemetry tags to measure conversion & latency.
Carlos Mendes: Action items: finance to finalize caps, legal to add SKU lock + abuse + renewal language, product to add telemetry tags and confirm burst implementation, marketing to draft listing blurb, partnerships to confirm partner OK and timeline. Target: finalize by next Wed EOD.
mp-bot: Reminder: partnership review meeting Tue 11:00am.
Maya Chen: Added meeting invite. Thanks everyone :rocket:
